a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first would very likely leave us both with nothing. So I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you openly rather than surprising you. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after that so the reserve can refill for you. If you'd rather propose a different fair split, tell me now.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
